data.description: Generates video (with synchronized audio) from text using BFL FLUX 3 Video via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt` and optional `aspect_ratio`/`duration`/`resolution`/`generate_audio`/`seed`. `duration` is a STRING of seconds ("5".."20") or "auto".

Generates video from text using MiniMax Hailuo 03 (MiniMax H3) via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt` and optional `resolution` (768P/2K)/`aspect_ratio`/`duration` (4–15s)/`seed`/`watermark`.

Generates video from text using ByteDance Seedance via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt` and optional `resolution` / `ratio` / `duration` / `seed`. For a cheaper, faster draft pass, set `model` to `Seedance 2.0 Mini` (~half the price of standard, ~2× faster than fast; 480p/720p only, 4–15s); `Seedance 2.0 Fast` (720p) and the default `Seedance 2.0` (up to 1080p) are the other tiers. For clips longer than 15s set `model` to `Seedance 2.5` (newest model, up to 30s, up to 1080p).

Generates video from text using Kling V3 via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt` and optional `negative_prompt`/`resolution`/`aspect_ratio`/`duration`/`generate_audio`/`seed`. `duration` is an integer number of seconds (3–15), not a string.

Generates video from text using Kling 3.0 Turbo (speed-optimized, native audio) via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. `duration` is an integer number of seconds (3–15), not a string.

Generates video (with AI audio) from text using LTX-2.5 via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt`; the tier goes in `params.model` (default `LTX-2.5 (Fast)`, clips up to 20s and up to 3840x2160; `LTX-2.5 (Pro)` is 2/3/4/5/6/8/10s at up to 1920x1080). Optional `duration`/`resolution`/`fps` are STRINGS ("8", "1920x1080", "25"), plus `generate_audio`/`seed`. A Fast clip over 10s needs a 720p/1080p resolution at 24/25 fps. No `aspect_ratio` knob — `resolution` sets the orientation (e.g. `"1080x1920"` for portrait).

Generates video from text using Google Veo 3 via a real Comfy Cloud workflow run. Output is saved to the asset library with a reopenable graph. Pass `prompt`; the tier goes in `params.model` (default `veo-3.1-generate`, the flagship). Optional `negative_prompt`/`aspect_ratio`/`resolution`/`duration_seconds` (4, 6 or 8)/`generate_audio`/`seed`. 4k renders on the `veo-3.1-generate` and `veo-3.1-fast-generate` tiers only.
